speaker: Doctor
text: Hey, I'm Dr. Iris. I'm going to be looking at your eyes today.

speaker: Doctor
text: This is Sam. He is also getting eye drops today. Click on Sam to say hi.

speaker: Sam
text: Hi! I'm Sam, nice to meet you.

speaker: Doctor
text: In order to see into your eye, I'll need to use some special eye drops. The drops make your pupil nice and big, so that I can see all the way inside.

speaker: Doctor
text: Sam, you're up first. Hop into the chair so we can see how it's done.

speaker: Doctor
text: When I put the drops in, they will be cold and may sting for a little bit. Lots of kids say it's not so bad. You're going to do great!

speaker: Doctor
text: Make sure to blink to spread the drop around. Then I can take a look inside your eye.

speaker: Doctor
text: Now it's your turn! Click on the chair to have a seat.

speaker: Doctor
text: Make sure to keep your head back and eyes open. Remember, the drops will feel cold and may sting for a little bit.

speaker: Doctor
text: Hold the button to keep your eye open!

speaker: Doctor
text: Make sure to keep your head back and eyes open.

speaker: Doctor
text: You did it! Now blink! The drops need to spread around.

speaker: Doctor
text: Amazing! Now I'll just take a quick look into your eye.
